verses.restored: In those days also saw I Jews that had married wives of Ashdod, of Ammon, and of Moab:

familiar.text: In those days also saw I Jews that had married wives of Ashdod, of Ammon, and of Moab:

modern.text: In those days I also saw Jews who had married women from Ashdod, Ammon, and Moab.

original.text: גַּ֣ם בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֗ם רָאִ֤יתִי אֶת הַיְּהוּדִים֙ הֹשִׁ֗יבוּ נָשִׁים֙ אשדודיות עמוניות מוֹאֲבִיּֽוֹת

verses.restored: And their children spoke half in the speech of Ashdod, and could not speak in the Jews’ language, but according to the language of each people.

familiar.text: And their children spake half in the speech of Ashdod, and could not speak in the Jews’ language, but according to the language of each people.

modern.text: Half of their children spoke the language of Ashdod or of the other peoples, but could not speak the language of Judah.

original.text: וּבְנֵיהֶ֗ם חֲצִי֙ מְדַבֵּ֣ר אַשְׁדּוֹדִ֔ית וְאֵינָ֥ם מַכִּירִ֖ים לְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוּדִ֑ית וְכִלְשׁ֖וֹן עַ֥ם וָעָֽם

verses.restored: And I contended with them, and cursed them, and smote certain of them, and plucked off their hair, and made them swear by God, saying, You shall not give your daughters to their sons, nor take their daughters to your sons, or for yourselves.

familiar.text: And I contended with them, and cursed them, and smote certain of them, and plucked off their hair, and made them swear by God, saying, Ye shall not give your daughters unto their sons, nor take their daughters unto your sons, or for yourselves.

notes.title: Nehemiah’s violence
notes.body: The narrator reports Nehemiah cursing, striking, and pulling hair. Reporting a leader’s conduct is not the same as ethically endorsing it.

modern.text: I rebuked them and called down curses on them. I beat some of these men and pulled out their hair. Then I made them take an oath before God and said, “You must not give your daughters in marriage to their sons or take their daughters as wives for your sons or for yourselves!

original.text: וָאָרִ֤יב עִמָּם֙ וָאֲקַֽלְלֵ֔ם וָאַכֶּ֥ה מֵהֶ֛ם אֲנָשִׁ֖ים וָֽאֶמְרְטֵ֑ם וָאַשְׁבִּיעֵ֣ם בֵּֽאלֹהִ֗ים אִם תִּתְּנ֤וּ בְנֹֽתֵיכֶם֙ לִבְנֵיהֶ֔ם וְאִם תִּשְׂאוּ֙ מִבְּנֹ֣תֵיהֶ֔ם לִבְנֵיכֶ֖ם וְלָכֶֽם

verses.restored: Did not Solomon king of Israel sin by these things? yet among many nations was there no king like him, who was beloved of his God, and God made him king over all Israel: nevertheless even him did outlandish women cause to sin.

familiar.text: Did not Solomon king of Israel sin by these things? yet among many nations was there no king like him, who was beloved of his God, and God made him king over all Israel: nevertheless even him did outlandish women cause to sin.

modern.text: Did not King Solomon of Israel sin in matters like this? There was not a king like him among many nations, and he was loved by his God, who made him king over all Israel—yet foreign women drew him into sin.

original.text: הֲל֣וֹא עַל אֵ֣לֶּה חָטָֽא שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל וּבַגּוֹיִ֣ם הָרַבִּים֩ לֹֽא הָיָ֨ה מֶ֜לֶךְ כָּמֹ֗הוּ וְאָה֤וּב לֵֽאלֹהָיו֙ הָיָ֔ה וַיִּתְּנֵ֣הוּ אֱלֹהִ֔ים מֶ֖לֶךְ עַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל גַּם אוֹת֣וֹ הֶחֱטִ֔יאוּ הַנָּשִׁ֖ים הַנָּכְרִיּֽוֹת

verses.restored: Shall we then listen to you to do all this great evil, to transgress against our God in marrying strange wives?

familiar.text: Shall we then hearken unto you to do all this great evil, to transgress against our God in marrying strange wives?

modern.text: Must we now hear that you too are doing all this terrible evil and acting unfaithfully against our God by marrying foreign women?”

original.text: וְלָכֶ֣ם הֲנִשְׁמַ֗ע לַעֲשֹׂת֙ אֵ֣ת כָּל הָרָעָ֤ה הַגְּדוֹלָה֙ הַזֹּ֔את לִמְעֹ֖ל בֵּֽאלֹהֵ֑ינוּ לְהֹשִׁ֖יב נָשִׁ֥ים נָכְרִיּֽוֹת

verses.restored: And one of the sons of Joiada, the son of Eliashib the high priest, was son in law to Sanballat the Horonite: therefore I chased him from me.

familiar.text: And one of the sons of Joiada, the son of Eliashib the high priest, was son in law to Sanballat the Horonite: therefore I chased him from me.

modern.text: Even one of the sons of Jehoiada son of Eliashib the high priest had become a son-in-law to Sanballat the Horonite. Therefore I drove him away from me.

original.text: וּמִבְּנֵ֨י יוֹיָדָ֤ע בֶּן אֶלְיָשִׁיב֙ הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַגָּד֔וֹל חָתָ֖ן לְסַנְבַלַּ֣ט הַחֹרֹנִ֑י וָאַבְרִיחֵ֖הוּ מֵעָלָֽי

verses.restored: Remember them, O my God, because they have defiled the priesthood, and the covenant of the priesthood, and of the Levites.

familiar.text: Remember them, O my God, because they have defiled the priesthood, and the covenant of the priesthood, and of the Levites.

modern.text: Remember them, O my God, because they have defiled the priesthood and the covenant of the priesthood and of the Levites.

original.text: זָכְרָ֥ה לָהֶ֖ם אֱלֹהָ֑י עַ֚ל גָּאֳלֵ֣י הַכְּהֻנָּ֔ה וּבְרִ֥ית הַכְּהֻנָּ֖ה וְהַלְוִיִּֽם

verses.restored: Thus cleansed I them from all strangers, and appointed the wards of the priests and the Levites, every one in his business;

familiar.text: Thus cleansed I them from all strangers, and appointed the wards of the priests and the Levites, every one in his business;

modern.text: Thus I purified the priests and Levites from everything foreign, and I assigned specific duties to each of the priests and Levites.

original.text: וְטִֽהַרְתִּ֖ים מִכָּל נֵכָ֑ר וָאַעֲמִ֧ידָה מִשְׁמָר֛וֹת לַכֹּהֲנִ֥ים וְלַלְוִיִּ֖ם אִ֥ישׁ בִּמְלַאכְתּֽוֹ

verses.restored: And for the wood offering, at times appointed, and for the firstfruits. Remember me, O my God, for good.

familiar.text: And for the wood offering, at times appointed, and for the firstfruits. Remember me, O my God, for good.

modern.text: I also arranged for contributions of wood at the appointed times, and for the firstfruits. Remember me, O my God, with favor.

original.text: וּלְקֻרְבַּ֧ן הָעֵצִ֛ים בְּעִתִּ֥ים מְזֻמָּנ֖וֹת וְלַבִּכּוּרִ֑ים זָכְרָה לִּ֥י אֱלֹהַ֖י לְטוֹבָֽה
